scene: You step off the harbor ferry into glowing Neon Harbor.
picture: On a wooden pier, the harbour ferry rests docked at far left. The young Black woman with a round afro, yellow raincoat, and green boots stands on the left holding a red umbrella. A glowing fish stall sits at centre, a tall crane on the right, and a cargo tram far right.
shown: a glowing fish stall lined with sparkling blue jellyfish on ice at centre
a tall yellow cargo crane with an attached metal ladder on the right
an open-air cargo tram waiting with open sliding doors on the far right

variants.scene: Your green boots hit the wooden pier under glowing neon fish signs.
You arrive at the bustling docks, still searching for {quest}.
Salty harbor air greets you beside a stall full of glowing blue jellyfish.
